Capacity assessment

Scenario synthetic <local> fixture · environment development · target http://127.0.0.1:18080 · campaign started 2026-10-19T12:00:00Z. Generated offline from saved evidence; no traffic was sent to produce this report.

Executive summary

The application did not sustain 8 concurrent active virtual users doing the "synthetic <local> fixture" journey with request p95 under 500 ms and request errors under 1.00%. No sustainable level is approved.

measured fact Decision confidence: NOT_ESTABLISHED; measurement quality: LIMITED. 0 of 2 repeat trials passed; the exact 95% interval for the repeat pass rate is 15.8% to 100.0%, assuming independent, stationary trials.

measured fact Observed limit (knee): every measurement passed at 4 virtual users, and objectives were breached at 8 virtual users (worst request p95 740 ms, errors 4.11%). The limit lies between these levels; short exploration probes are not approvals.

hypothesis Correlational, not a measured root cause: throughput rose only from 56.0 to 70.0 successful requests/s while load rose from 4 to 8 virtual users, which suggests the system was saturating between these levels; and the workflows checkout breached objectives first. No diagnostic evidence in this report proves which resource saturated.

What this does NOT mean

  • Virtual users are simulated clients repeating the recorded journey with only the pauses the scenario declares. They are not registered users, logged-in accounts, connected sessions, requests in flight or requests per second.
  • The result applies only to the tested journey mix, environment and duration. It is not a prediction for other workloads, peak events or future releases.
  • No usage assumption (think time or actions per person) was declared, so no estimate of real people is shown. Real people usually outnumber active virtual users because they pause between actions.

Modeled active users are closed-loop virtual users of the recorded workload. They are not people, connected sessions, requests in flight or requests per second.

Conclusion

The requested demand of 8 modeled active users was not met. The campaign at 8 modeled active users breached its predeclared objectives for scenario "synthetic <local> fixture" in the declared development environment over a required phase duration of 20s. No level is approved under these conditions.

Choose between investigating the breached workflows listed below (root causes are not identified by this report) and accepting a lower demand target that must then be tested exactly. Do not size for the requested demand from this evidence.

First remediation: Investigate the breach, then repeat the campaign at the exact target.

Limitations and uncertainty

  • This assessment describes the saved evidence under its declared conditions. It does not certify universal or human-user capacity, establish dependence-aware confidence, or recommend infrastructure changes.
  • Percentiles are nearest-rank descriptive estimates; statistical intervals assume independent, stationary samples, which this assessment does not establish.
  • The workload mix is not independently validated.
  • Observed results apply only to the recorded workload.
